title: Direct ElevenLabs psychedelic voice demo
acceptance: A public /voice-demo route offers editable original short text, a server-listed voice and a continuous psychedelic fractal preset without Settings, Library or Workshop detours.
Returning verified administrators and subscribers can Begin from the form with an explicit audio gesture; fresh server entitlement/readiness and existing Worker limits remain authoritative.
Provider refusal, malformed audio or decode failure keeps the draft and failure message on the form without a silent or alternate voice reading. Duplicate pending Begin makes one request.
Draft and selected voice/look survive full-page administrator sign-in and successful Chamber exit; explicit Reset and existing Clear browser data remove the retained draft.

Focused and required CI tests pass, browser evidence shows a painted fractal field, and real production administrator/subscriber audio is witnessed after external configuration is ready. Mocked provider evidence alone is not production acceptance.

evidence.note: TDD covers authoritative readiness, admission, draft/sign-in retention, duplicate submission and router rollback refusal.
Local endpoint fixture with decodable audio; no vendor call or production acceptance.

86-file unit subset passed 1,930 tests with 2 existing skips; full browser gate passed 56 with 3 existing skips. Final demo tests use a local decodable provider fixture and no autoplay override; production access/audio has not been accepted.
